parameters.name: ReferenceId
parameters.description: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. The value must be 6 to 64 characters in length and is unique at the user level.

parameters.name: VideoId
parameters.description:
The audio or video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- For videos uploaded by using the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the audio or video ID.
- If the audio or video is uploaded by calling the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation, the audio or video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
- After the audio or video is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
